events.verdict: Jackson (LAC) extends his hands into Small (MEM) to disengage and create space.
Replay review of the out of bounds called on Leonard (LAC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Leonard is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Jackson (LAC) reaches in and the contact with Coward (MEM) is marginal as he loses control of his dribble.
Coward (MEM) jumps from point A to point B into Leonard (LAC), affecting his layup attempt.
Jackson (LAC) gets his hand firmly on the ball and Jerome (MEM) returns to the floor. A held ball is whistled and there is no illegal contact by Jackson.
Jerome (MEM) makes illegal contact to Miller's (LAC) wrist, affecting his shot attempt.
Jackson (LAC) jumps forward to contest Jerome's (MEM) shot attempt at the rim, but the body contact is marginal.
Small (MEM) commits a take foul on Mathurin (LAC).
Jones Jr. (LAC) legally contests Jerome's (MEM) jump shot attempt.
